versions.changelog:
Version 1.2.5

- No file changes detected in this release.
- Functionality and documentation remain unchanged from the previous version.

Initial release of cn-diff-checker.

- Compare differences between two texts or files.
- Supports line, word, and character level diff.
- Pure Python implementation using the standard difflib library.
- No external dependencies or API keys required.
- Outputs ANSI-colored differences.
- Auto-detects file or string input.
